subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the Marketing Coordinator position at our company. We have carefully reviewed your qualifications and are impressed with your experience in digital marketing and social media management. We would like to invite you for an interview to further discuss your application. Please let us know your availability for the upcoming week. We look forward to meeting you in person. Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
